sloka: स तां बाणसहस्रेण विक्षोभ्य हरिवाहिनीम्।हरिश्रेष्ठं हनूमन्तमिन्द्रजित् प्रत्युवाच ह ।। ६.८१.२७ ।।
transliteration: sa tāṁ bāṇasahasreṇa vikṣobhya harivāhinīm।hariśreṣṭhaṁ hanūmantamindrajit pratyuvāca ha ।। 6.81.27 ।।

translations.english: "O Vanara! This day, having killed her, I will kill Rama, Lakshmana, and you, also Sugriva and that ignoble Vibheeshana."
